newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Tablex started neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tablex started neutral.

text.p: Bear Stearns said in a report on Tuesday it initiated coverage of Mexican pasta and cookie maker Tablex with a neutral rating.

"The prospects for Tablex can quickly change, however, on news of an end to the current pasta price wars, short-term debt refinancing and or clear statements by management defining the company's long-term growth strategy," analyst Mark Abramson wrote.
Abramson said the company has been very cost efficient but recent administrative cuts "may have cut some meat, not just fat."
"Working capital shortage chewed up more than $20 million last year, almost all of the company's operating cash flow. This deficit was financed with expensive short-term debt," he wrote.
The company lacks a long-term vision, he added, and could face future increased competition from multinationals.
Tablex stock stood at 26 pesos at the end of trading on Friday, the last day it traded.
